evidence_spans: Here, we propose a highly efficient DFT-based method aided by a specially designed machine learning potential.

As the machine learning potential can closely reproduce the ab initio phase-space distribution, even for multi-component alloys, the costly thermodynamic integration can be fully substituted with more efficient free energy perturbation calculations.
The method achieves overall savings of computational resources by 80% compared to current alternatives.
